results.title: Gordon Monson: Despite football success, is the Utah athletics department led by Mark Harlan rotting from the inside out?
results.description: Utah football is thriving under Morgan Scalley, but questions about Mark Harlan's leadership, basketball support and internal relationships persist, writes Gordon Monson.

results.title: Meet the musicians behind the viral ‘LeBron, LeBron, LeBron’ song — and, yes, the Sixers star has heard it
results.description: Two amateur musicians and LeBron James fans — one at Iowa State and one in Vancouver — created similar covers of Steve Lacy’s “oh yeah?” that pay tribute to the Sixers forward.

results.title: Cardinals Must Fix Their Run Defense After Rams Ran for 202 Yards, With Chiefs Next
results.description: The Rams ran 46 times for 202 yards against the Cardinals, and Arizona now loses two defenders to injured reserve before Kenneth Walker III and the Chiefs.

results.title: Ruturaj Gaikwad has been quite stubborn: Ambati Rayudu wants CSK skipper to step up as batter
results.description: Former India and CSK batter Ambati Rayudu believes Ruturaj Gaikwad has been stubborn in his approach and needs to step up as a batter for the five-time champions after MS Dhoni’s departure.
